_about: Global predefined lab test library. internal_code (JLT-####) is a Jido-generated identifier, NOT LOINC or any recognised coding standard. Codes are frozen: never renumber; append new tests with the next free code. Names come from the MedlinePlus lab-test index (source=medlineplus_index) or are standard routine clinic tests (source=common_clinic). Category assignments must be validated clinically before production use. description/reference_url are left null unless clinically verified text is available.
